flowers.prompt: Generate one square 1024x1024 botanical illustration, transparent PNG background, for a small square panel on The Vegetable Guru book cover. Reference images 1 and 2 are AUTHORITATIVE BOOK DRAWING STYLE ONLY: bold simplified silhouettes, dimensional vector-like shapes using broad discrete coloured planes, crisp organic contours, a few graphic tapered cream highlight strokes, strong readable volume. No photographic surface, grain, watercolor, etched texture, fine veins/root-hair networks, black outlines or glow. Reference 3 is a REAL PHOTO that supplies the exact subject and natural arrangement. Preserve its irregular pose, perspective, partial occlusions and unequal angles. Do NOT substitute a generic hero composition. No text, frame, label, pot, photo background or shadow cloud. Clean alpha, no halo. All main silhouettes complete inside the square with roughly 5% empty margin; no cut-off fruit. This image will appear at only about 55mm square, so keep it clear and bold. Draw the actual courgette plant shown in photo 3: the upright small developing DARK GREEN COURGETTE immediately below the yellow flower MUST be visible and recognisable, including its subtle ribbing and wilted blossom at its lower end. The source has two yellow blooms upper left/middle, radiating crossing green stems and a big lobed leaf on right. Preserve this observed plant arrangement in simplified house style; show a modest amount of foliage rather than a whole plant. The front yellow flower should occupy only about 30% of the panel width, NOT a huge decorative flower taking over the image. Show enough small green courgette body below it to read as a vegetable plant. Simplify leaf damage to an irregular natural contour. Omit soil, timber, label and damaged yellow foreground leaf. Maintain golden yellow flowers and rich greens, with tapered cream highlights.
